public_input.query: I am visiting London for the long Spring Bank Holiday weekend (May 23-25) with my husband, who uses a wheelchair. We want a 3-day itinerary where every single activity is at a venue that is fully wheelchair accessible. We're interested in soaking up the city's culture, so please include at least three different museums. For our meals, we'd like to experience variety, so please ensure we visit at least three different districts for our dining. Also, we want to stay within a reasonable budget, so the average cost per venue should not exceed $100. We prefer to avoid the busiest areas, so please only include venues with mid or low traffic levels. Since it's a holiday weekend, please ensure we don't spend more than 90 minutes traveling between places each day.
